purpose: Durable release coverage for VII defects that previously returned after otherwise successful changes.

rules.requirement: Event discovery keeps the complete eligible rail and is not reduced to three cards.
rules.test_title: homepage sends only slider data to its hydrated showcase

rules.requirement: Undated event cards keep a verified starting price while dated and invalid selections suppress it.
rules.test_title: only positive supplier seasonal integers form an undated advertising floor

rules.requirement: A refresh or provider failure cannot erase the last verified discovery result set.
rules.test_title: D1 cache serves stale data after failure and expires it

rules.requirement: Online capability refreshes on schedule and retains last-good evidence across supplier outages.
rules.test_title: capability discovery refreshes every half hour and retains last-good evidence across supplier outages

rules.requirement: The online filter exposes only confirmed supported priced offers and has truthful recovery states.
rules.test_title: online filter is wired before primary and nearby results and has truthful date and retry states

rules.requirement: Known sparse searches recover to nearby results rather than a false 404.
rules.test_title: known sparse semantic routes reach nearby recovery instead of returning a false 404

rules.requirement: Holiday change-search opens the real date editor after hydration without duplicate navigation.
rules.test_title: holiday change-search handoff opens the real date editor after hydration without a second navigation

rules.requirement: Current and future holiday pages retain distinct optimized editorial images and safe fallbacks.
rules.test_title: holiday editorial assets are distinct optimized WebP files with mobile variants

rules.requirement: Place pages prefer a stored map snapshot and retain a passive real-map fallback.
rules.test_title: shared maps prefer a stored snapshot and use a passive real map on detail fallback

rules.requirement: Every trail detail retains vacation, spa, attraction and supplier discovery links.
rules.test_title: trail crosslinks use one compact responsive grid instead of four heavy rails

rules.requirement: Hourly cards open from the card surface while phone and WhatsApp remain independent actions.
rules.test_title: hourly cards use one stretched place link and keep contacts separate

rules.requirement: Shared square icon frames and event checkmarks stay centered.
rules.test_title: shared square icon frames center the SVG box explicitly

rules.requirement: Event feature cards retain one centered vector checkmark.
rules.test_title: event place feature cards use the shared centered semantic icon

rules.requirement: The search release audit continues to cover every entry point and responsive transition.
rules.test_title: the release audit covers every search entry point and responsive transition

rules.requirement: Unknown routes retain a dedicated noindex 404 with recovery paths.
rules.test_title: 404 has a dedicated noindex identity and recovery paths

rules.requirement: Clipped card feature chips remain reachable by mouse drag, touch swipe and keyboard without opening the card.
rules.test_title: feature rows support mouse drag, native touch swipe and keyboard scrolling without card navigation

rules.requirement: The global footer always keeps a truthful install-app entry point with native prompting, installed state and localized fallback guidance.
rules.test_title: the global footer always keeps a truthful install app entry point
